name: Kazuchimon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if [Leon Alexander] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.) until the end of their turn.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If you have 3 or more security cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn. If you have 3 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your security stack, if this Digimon has [Fenriloogamon] in its name, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -8000 DP for the turn.
